description: The same fixture on a HILLSIDE: three tanks at facing 200 across the slope the tascene-air fixture puts the Thunder over, where the terrain gives them real bank and pitch in the unit's angle triple at +0x64 (measured 2026-09-08: +17.4/-22.1 degrees, 0/-30.7, 0/+1.8). This is what separates a selection box rotated by the heading alone from one that takes the whole triple the engine does.
